title: Base-extension cap rollback deletes an external owner before skipped generation

source_observation.environment: Exact public 3.2.10 archive SHA-256 5D88F2F971622E04846F6FC26859777F429C71FE34ECD9250AB2BA56B9A4C1B7 on Steam Factorio 2.1.14.87180.
source_observation.fact: With mir-max-level-worker-robots-storage=3, below the first MIR continuation level 4, MIR skips its replacement but the external owner better-worker-robots-storage-infinite has already been removed.

reproducer.expected: Retain the external owner and original dependent prerequisite when absolute cap policy makes MIR generation inapplicable.
reproducer.observed: The external owner is deleted before MIR declines to generate the replacement.

required_correction: Make external-owner removal transactional with the complete replacement plan, so a cap-based skipped generation leaves the owner and every dependent prerequisite untouched.

closure.reason: Transactional replacement now validates materialization before removing an external owner; exact target qualification passed and both corrected releases were publicly byte-verified on GitHub.
